name: Furry Spring Break
description: Furry Spring Break (FSB) was a furry convention held in Orlando, Florida, on March 2 to 4, 2001, at the Ramada Resort and Convention Center. It was announced in late 1999 with a 2001 launch date, chaired by Matt Henry (Cutter Coon) with programming led by Karl F. Meyers. A second edition planned for March 2002 did not go ahead after a new hotel contract could not be obtained, and a group of area furs, including several former staffers, incorporated and created Pawpet Megaplex in response.
